goal.outcome: Build a script that merges 5-6 monthly CSVs, totals by department, and saves to Excel

concepts.label: Syntax and data types
concepts.can_do: Read and write variables, conditionals and loops, and recognise errors caused by confusing numbers with strings
concepts.why: The floor everything else stands on

concepts.label: Tabular data with lists and dicts
concepts.can_do: Read a CSV row into a list, total it by department name as the key, and filter with a comprehension
concepts.why: 'totals by department' is exactly this operation

concepts.label: Wrapping repeated work in functions
concepts.can_do: Turn the code that handles one file into a function and run it over six
concepts.why: Copy-pasting means editing six places every month

concepts.label: Reading errors and handling exceptions
concepts.can_do: Find the failing line in a traceback, and keep processing when one file is broken

concepts.label: Files, paths and encoding
concepts.can_do: Read CSV and write Excel, and fix mojibake when cp949 and utf-8 disagree
concepts.why: The entry and exit of the goal; encoding is where Korean CSVs almost always break

concepts.label: Packages and virtual environments
concepts.can_do: Install and use packages like openpyxl, and recognise a broken environment
concepts.why: Saving to Excel needs a third-party package
